entries.title: Right Drug, Right Dose, Right Now
entries.summary: The beginning of personalized preventative medicine.
entries.body: MyEngene is an engine for your genes. By analyzing genetic profiles, we assess the effectiveness of prescribed drugs and help patients and physicians choose safer, more effective therapies.

entries.title: Adverse Drug Reactions (ADR)
entries.summary: ADR is the 4th leading cause of death in the USA. 128,000 Americans die annually from adverse drug reactions.
entries.body: There is a lack of use and understanding of genomics to help prescribe the right medicine and reduce hospitalizations and deaths. 128,000 Americans die each year from adverse drug reactions and their side effects. Pharmacogenomics uses information about a person's genetic makeup to choose drugs and doses likely to work best. MyEngene claims adverse drug reaction pain, suffering, and costs can be reduced by up to 95%.

entries.title: Vision and Mission
entries.summary: MyEngene started with a vision to truly personalize medicine.
entries.body: MyEngene is an engine for your genes. An individual's unique DNA can make some medications ineffective or dangerous. The only way to know which medications are safe is through a genomic test and advanced analysis. Our mission is to create a positive healthcare experience by elevating the standard of care that patients deserve. Proactive, preventative, personalized medicine.

entries.title: 97% Genetic Variation Stat
entries.summary: 97% of people have genetic variants that affect medication response.
entries.body: One-size-fits-all medication does not work. 97% of us have genetic variations which may severely impact the response to a normally safe drug. These variants cannot be reliably identified by family history, blood tests, or other routine methods. Almost 99% of people carry genes that impact how they respond to medication.

entries.title: How It Works
entries.summary: Four steps from genome to actionable reports.
entries.body: Step 1: Acquire genome in digital format. Step 2: Analyze genome sequence. Step 3: File uploaded at MyEngene. Step 4: Get reports and updates. For at-home collection: open your MyEngene kit, swab the inside of your cheek for 30 seconds, place the swab in the tube and mail it. Reports typically delivered in 5-7 business days.

entries.title: Personalized Medicine
entries.summary: Translate your genome into clinically meaningful information.
entries.body: Adverse drug reactions send millions to the ER, urgent care centers, and their own doctors every year. MyEngene personalizes medicine by translating your genome into clinically meaningful information. Our technology has the potential to transform how we think about, diagnose, and treat health issues.

entries.title: Proactive Care
entries.summary: Receive optimized prescription drug guidelines in seconds.
entries.body: After a few seconds of processing, you or your physician receive guidelines that optimize your prescription drugs. The platform continuously learns and adapts using artificial intelligence and cloud-based software to provide actionable information.

entries.title: Preventative Medicine
entries.summary: Identify unsafe medications before adverse reactions occur.
entries.body: Not all prescription drugs are safe for everyone. 97% of us have genetic variants that can cause a normally safe drug to be ineffective or even deadly. MyEngene provides doctors with a clinical tool to suggest better treatment and therapies before harm occurs.

entries.title: MyEngene Platform
entries.summary: Pharmacogenomics platform using ML and AI for personalized drug recommendations.
entries.body: MyEngene is a pharmacogenomics platform for individuals and healthcare professionals, utilizing machine learning and artificial intelligence to translate a patient's genetic makeup into personalized drug recommendations. Platform as a service featuring genomics, bioinformatics, and machine learning to provide insights into DNA variations that lead to poor drug response.

entries.title: AI-Driven Analysis
entries.summary: Proprietary AI algorithms generate reports with up-to-date drug and dosing recommendations.
entries.body: The platform generates a report based on a person's genome through machine learning and proprietary AI algorithms. Information is rapidly analyzed to provide the most up-to-date drug and dosing recommendations possible. Recommendations maximize drug effectiveness while minimizing drug toxicity.

entries.title: Pharmacogenomics Datalake
entries.summary: Comprehensive datalake including dosing guidelines, diagnostics, and NGS.
entries.body: MyEngene maintains a comprehensive pharmacogenomics datalake including dosing guidelines, disease diagnostics, next-generation sequencing data, and AI-based technology. These advances save lives, reduce hospital admissions and stays, and lower costs.

entries.title: Whole Genome Sequencing at 30X
entries.summary: Complete coverage of 3.2 billion base pairs at 30X depth.
entries.body: MyEngene uses Whole Genome Sequencing at 30X depth for the most complete picture possible. We analyze all 3.2 billion base pairs. 30X depth ensures highly accurate, reliable results and captures rare variants that typical SNP panels miss.

entries.title: Hybrid Intelligence Model
entries.summary: Separates deterministic interpretation from AI communication for clinical safety.
entries.body: MyEngene strategically separates deterministic interpretation from AI communication. Deterministic knowledge base is automated and continuously updated with FDA alerts and PGx databases. Every conclusion follows strict, evidence-backed rules. AI-powered communication translates complex results into personalized, easy-to-understand language with zero room for AI improvisation. 100% explainable AI with traceable rationale.

entries.title: 990+ Drug Coverage
entries.summary: Instant insights on 990+ drugs powered by genetics and real-time updates.
entries.body: Get instant insights on 990+ drugs, powered by patient genetics and real-time updates. Understand drug-to-gene, drug-to-drug, and lifestyle interactions in a single view. Visual polypharmacy matrix helps assess safety across all current medications. Genotype simulation models risk when genetic data is incomplete.

entries.title: 1,110 Genes Analyzed
entries.summary: Unmatched genetic coverage across 1,110 genes.
entries.body: MyEngene provides analysis across 1,110 genes with comprehensive drug profiles for 990+ medications, offering unmatched genetic coverage compared to typical providers capped around 500 drugs.

entries.title: PGx Summary
entries.summary: MyEngene provides the most comprehensive PGx reporting in the industry.
entries.body: MyEngene provides the most comprehensive pharmacogenomic reporting in the industry. The platform translates patient genes into personalized drug recommendations to maximize effectiveness and minimize toxicity. Identifies DNA variations leading to dysfunctional enzymes affecting drug metabolism. Physicians receive clear reports to confidently suggest optimal therapies. Covers 990+ drugs across 1,110 genes. Reports include dosing guidelines, drug-gene interactions, drug-drug interactions, and lifestyle factors. Delivered in 5-7 business days with physician review. Reduces adverse drug reactions — the 4th leading cause of death in the USA affecting 128,000 Americans annually. Potential to reduce ADR costs by up to 95%.

entries.title: Is PGx For Me?
entries.summary: Guide to who benefits from pharmacogenomic testing.
entries.body: PGx testing may be right for you if you: take prescription medications and want to know if they suit your DNA; manage chronic health conditions like diabetes, heart disease, or high blood pressure; have a family history of drug reactions or allergies; undergo psychiatric, cancer, or cardiac care requiring critical treatments; have experienced trial-and-error with medications without relief; want proactive, preventative personalized medicine. 70% or more receive at least one prescription annually that may not suit their DNA. 97% carry genetic variants affecting medication response. Providers evaluating PGx should consider integration into daily clinical practice across psychiatry, cardiology, oncology, and primary care.

entries.title: Data Privacy and Security
entries.summary: HIPAA, GDPR, PIPEDA, and CCPA compliant with full user control.
entries.body: Genetic data safeguarded with encryption, anonymization, and strict privacy measures. 99.9% data encryption rate. Exceeds HIPAA, GDPR, PIPEDA, and CCPA requirements. Users control who accesses their genetic report with 100% user access authorization. CLIA/CAP certified laboratory processing.

entries.title: Lifetime Medication Safety Monitoring
entries.summary: Continuous drug compatibility monitoring with real-time alerts.
entries.body: MyEngene transforms static genetic tests into dynamic health protection. Continuous pharmacovigilance with real-time updates. Lifetime monitoring as new drugs, interactions, and risks emerge. Over 95% accuracy in compatibility checks. Instant drug risk alerts. Evolving guideline access for personalized treatment.

entries.title: What is PGx testing?
entries.summary: Pharmacogenomic testing analyzes how your genes affect drug response.
entries.body: Pharmacogenomic (PGx) testing examines your DNA to determine how your body metabolizes and responds to medications. MyEngene uses whole genome sequencing at 30X depth to provide the most comprehensive analysis available, covering 990+ drugs and 1,110 genes.

entries.title: How does PGx improve treatments?
entries.summary: PGx enables genetically matched prescriptions instead of trial-and-error.
entries.body: PGx replaces trial-and-error prescribing with genetically informed decisions. Physicians receive reports showing which drugs and doses are safe and effective for each patient, reducing adverse reactions and improving outcomes across specialties.

entries.title: Can PGx integrate into my workflow?
entries.summary: Yes — order review, instant reports, and patient management tools included.
entries.body: MyEngene provides tools to manage orders, patients, and reports. Track test orders in real-time, access pharmacogenomic reports instantly, and organize patient profiles in one secure platform. Integrations with laboratory partners and healthcare systems are available.

entries.title: Is PGx useful across specialties?
entries.summary: Yes — psychiatry, cardiology, oncology, and primary care all benefit.
entries.body: PGx is valuable across psychiatry, cardiology, oncology, primary care, dermatology, and more. Each specialty has documented case studies showing improved outcomes when prescribing is guided by genetic data.

entries.title: Is patient data secure?
entries.summary: Yes — HIPAA, GDPR, and PIPEDA compliant with encryption and user control.
entries.body: All genetic data is encrypted, anonymized where appropriate, and stored under HIPAA, GDPR, PIPEDA, and CCPA standards. Patients control who can access their reports.

entries.title: When will I get results?
entries.summary: Reports typically delivered in 5-7 business days.
entries.body: MyEngene reports are typically delivered within 5-7 business days after the lab receives your sample. Each report is reviewed by clinical pharmacists and licensed providers before delivery.

entries.title: Can I share results with my doctor?
entries.summary: Yes — reports are designed for easy sharing with your healthcare team.
entries.body: MyEngene reports include clear next steps and are formatted for physicians to act on immediately. You control access and can share results directly with your healthcare providers.
